### simpledb: async WAL removed, group commit is always on
- `simpledb.EnableAsyncWAL()` was removed. WAL writes are now always durable. Concurrent writes are batched into a single fsync (group commit).
* Add group-commit to SimpleDB and WAL  by @thomasjungblut in https://github.com/thomasjungblut/go-sstables/pull/75
- Tune batching with the new `simpledb.GroupCommitMaxBatchSize(n)` and `simpledb.GroupCommitMaxWait(d)` options.
- `simpledb.EnableDirectIOWAL()`

* SimpleDB now supports byte functions in addition to the string functions
* Add byte based functions to simpledb by @thomasjungblut in https://github.com/thomasjungblut/go-sstables/pull/56
* Compaction by tombstone ratio in simpledb by @thomasjungblut in https://github.com/thomasjungblut/go-sstables/pull/46

For an upgrade, keep the existing database, artifact storage, environment/configuration files, and instance ID. Installation does not restart a running server. Restart `swarmforge serve` deliberately and reconnect MCP clients to load the new executable and tools.

## SwarmForge v0.1.2

Linux x64 with glibc. The standalone executable includes its runtime; Bun is not required on the installation host.

### Included in this release

- Chibi terminal status overview with Tab switching to the technical dashboard. Selection, filters and history navigation are preserved.
- Fixed archive verification for relative release-asset paths, including the automated GitHub release workflow.
- Corrected dashboard credential-redaction regression coverage for both overview presentations
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liberusoftware/automation-laravel/compare/v8.0.1...v8.0.2

- Include Laravel security audit fixes and the reusable audit skill.
- Refresh dependencies, CI workflows, frontend assets and module integrations.
- Include Composer path repositories in Docker dependency build stages.

Full application test suite verified before publication.
